name: skillbox
description: The dependency-free core of the skillbox family. Fork a Claude Code conversation into a new session truncated at a chosen point and navigate the resulting fork tree; write settled research into ticket draft files using a fixed ticket structure; record settled architecture decisions as ADRs; keep the repository’s SDDs true as the code changes, and add research and outside facts to a knowledge base beside them, with a Stop hook that checks both and a start-of-turn hook that keeps an index of each current. Needs only Node.
